intervals: Whole old held interiors, all rolling0.6s subintervals, old midpoint±0.3s, and fixed0-0.8s non-held controls. No best-window-only reporting.
motion_measurements: Compare visible-orange centre, blue-glyph feature optical flow and camera/background motion. Flow follows image features, not true centre, contact or3D translation. Rotation and foreshortening separately unknown unless visually justified.

tracking.algorithm: OpenCV pyramidal Lucas-Kanade with per-pair forward/backward validation

low_motion_rule.qualification: Image-space low motion only. Must have visually verified object feature seeds, complete tracking support and visible held review. Both views support independent pause qualification; missing view stays unknown. Not exactzero or stationary3D.

future_frames: Offline motion audit and labels only; no predictor or live controller inputs.

reviewed_spatial_masks.review: Agent-reviewed full first/mid/last panels before flow measurements. Broad static workspace search; glyph selection does not use old orange centroid/bbox or previous flow. Largest blue component area>=10px; dilate3px for corners. Masks stored separately from original tracking.
